title: The King's Road Below
rumor: The King's Road Below. Old dwarven songs describe a great subterranean highway connecting the Lost Holds, wide enough for six wagons to travel abreast. Sections supposedly remain intact beneath Blackvein's mountains, together with bridges spanning chasms that no living traveler has measured. A goblin salvager claims to have found one of its mile markers.
first_lead: Cinderhook miners possess stone fragments bearing an ancient dwarven distance inscription.
